svg.style: background:#070a13; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

g.text: Single Canonical Daemon: flock Mutual Exclusion
Kernel-level file locking prevents socket clobbering, race conditions, and orphaned PTY sessions
Accepts GUI client & headless CLI traffic
Never unlinks ferryx.sock; prevents breaking active clients
Signals predecessor to enter drain state without killing sessions
Headless CLI commands forward IPC payloads and exit cleanly

text.tspan: Kernel enforces exclusive lock; eliminates PID race windows.
OS drops lock instantly if the daemon crashes or terminates.
Only the confirmed lock holder binds canonical
Legacy daemon serves existing PTYs until all clients disconnect.
Background upgrades never interrupt active agent tasks or builds.
Reconnecting clients resume seamlessly from ring buffer streams.
